json.account.link.description: Great news! You don't need to link an account to use this module. Just click on "skip" to go to the next page.
json.action.read.value.name: Read json value
json.action.read.value.description: Is used to find a value in json for a given key
json.action.read.value.input.path.name: Path
json.action.read.value.input.path.descri: The path to the json value
json.action.read.value.input.separator.d: The path separator. If nothing is set, a dot (.) is used by default
json.action.read.value.failure.not.found: An error occurred while reading a json value. The error occurred because the specified path could not be found completely in the content.
json.action.read.value.failure.wrong.for: An error occurred while reading a json value. The error has occurred because there is a syntax error in the JSON content.
json.action.read.array.name: Read json array
json.action.read.array.description: Is used to parse a json array
json.action.read.array.input.path.name: Path (optional)
json.action.read.array.input.path.descri: The path to the json array. If nothing is specified, the content is interpreted directly as an array
json.action.read.array.input.separator.d: The path separator. If nothing is set, a dot (.) is used by default
json.action.read.array.failure.not.found: An error occurred while reading a json array. The error occurred because the specified path could not be found completely in the content.
json.action.read.array.failure.wrong.for: An error occurred while reading a json array. The error has occurred because there is a syntax error in the JSON content.
json.action.read.array.index.name: Read json array index
json.action.read.array.index.description: Used to read the element of a JSON array at a specific index
The path to the json array. If nothing is specified, the content is interpreted directly as an array
json.action.read.array.index.input.separ: The path separator. If nothing is set, a dot (.) is used by default
json.action.read.array.index.input.index: The index at which the array is to be read out
json.action.read.array.index.failure.not: An error occurred while reading a json array index. The error occurred because the specified path could not be found completely in the content.
json.action.read.array.index.failure.wro: An error occurred while reading a json array index. The error has occurred because there is a syntax error in the JSON content.
json.action.read.array.index.failure.out: An error occurred while reading a json array index. The error has occurred because the index is outside the available indices of the array.
